title.value: Call for applications to the 42nd cycle of PhD programmes

field: Engineering, architecture and related PhD programmes
description_short: Second session of Politecnico di Torino's 42nd-cycle PhD call: applications open 15 October 2026 and close 16 November 2026, for programmes starting 1 March 2027. The call offers a minimum of 110 positions with scholarships across three sessions.
